title: Another child rape case against granite baron Veeramani 12 years after girl’s suicide

This new charge relates to the suicide of a 16-year-old girl in 2014, prompting her mother to file a complaint. The case remained dormant due to police record loss after a fire. The special investigation team is now looking into both incidents and collecting evidence from the public.

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: India win 8 medals but remain outside top 10
description: India won eight medals on Day 9 of the Asian Games, including four silver and four bronze. Notable performances included Yashvir Singh and Rohit Yadav securing silver and bronze in the men's javelin. Esha Singh earned silver in the women's 25m pistol, while several athletes contributed to the medal tally across different sports. Despite the successes, India's gold medal count remained at four, keeping it in 12th place overall.

Russian strikes on Kyiv kills 3 as Ukraine targets oil, military sites
description: In recent Russian strikes on Kyiv, three people lost their lives, including an Azerbaijani citizen. In Kharkiv, numerous injuries were documented. Ukraine retaliated with targeted counterstrikes against Russian oil and military sites, impacting areas such as Tula and Voronezh, while a railway bridge in Bryansk was also attacked. Ongoing Russian offensives are causing considerable destruction to vital infrastructure across the region, intensifying the conflict between both nations.

title: Watch: Narrow escape for woman as 300-year-old building collapses in Balasore
description: A two-storey building in Damodarpur, Balasore partially collapsed due to heavy rainfall and weakened structure. This nearly 300-year-old building had historical connections with Fakir Mohan Senapati, an Odia writer and litterateur. People from the family of Bachu Keshab Rao occupied the building over generations and still resided in part of it. Fortunately, there were no injuries or casualties from the incident that blocked a local road.

title: Stock market rout: Sensex sinks to 6-month low, Rs 17 lakh crore wiped out in a month
description: The sell-off intensified on Monday. The BSE benchmark plunged 1,124.02 points, or 1.52%, to close at 72,771.72, marking its lowest closing level since March 30, 2026. The Nifty fell 360.25 points, or 1.56%, to finish at 22,780.25, its lowest level in nearly six months. The weakness was also visible beyond the frontline indices. The BSE SmallCap Select index fell 1.90%, while the MidCap Select index declined 1.39%.

title: Punjab's poll drug debate has old players in new roles: BJP, Cong attack; AAP defends

Asian Games: Yashvir wins silver, Rohit bronze as Pathirage takes javelin gold
description: In a thrilling men's javelin throw at the Asian Games 2026, Yashvir Singh and Rohit Yadav won silver and bronze medals, respectively. The event saw the absence of defending champion Neeraj Chopra, who was out due to injury. Sri Lanka’s Rumesh Pathirage shone brightly, securing gold with a throw of 88.55m. Yashvir's personal best of 85.72m underscored India's remarkable performance, continuing the javelin legacy from 2023.

title: Travis Kelce’s $12.35M real estate empire: How did he build it?
description: Travis Kelce has built an impressive real estate portfolio spanning Kansas and Ohio. His reported properties include a 17,000-square-foot Leawood mansion, a 21,000-square-foot lakefront estate in Bratenahl and a former 10,000-square-foot Kansas City home. Together, the three properties cover nearly 48,000 square feet, with reported purchase prices totalling about $12.35 million. His Leawood home also reportedly served as the setting for his 2025 proposal to Taylor Swift.

title: Watch: Govt building collapses as heavy rains trigger fresh landslide in Nepal
description: A catastrophic landslide in Baskhola, Galkot Municipality-9, caused a ward office building to collapse into the Daram River. The disaster has resulted in a reported ten fatalities, while one person remains untraced following extreme weather conditions in Baglung. Swift rescue efforts are ongoing, supported by a helicopter from the Nepali army.

title: Nidhi Tiwari, influencer with 16 lakh followers, dies by suicide; final words stun fans
description: Nidhi Tiwari, a 30-year-old social media influencer, was found hanging at her residence in Singrauli. Her family reported that she had recently spoken to a youth from another state before her death. The local police are investigating the circumstances surrounding her death and have taken her body into custody. Tiwari had a significant following on social media, indicating her influence in the community.

title: Homebuyers, take note: These Indian cities saw housing sales rise in Q3
description: During the July to September quarter of 2026, residential housing sales in India revealed contrasting trends across major cities. While the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and Bengaluru reported a surge in transactions, Pune and Chennai faced notable declines. A total of 1,14,320 new residential units were introduced in seven cities, with average property prices climbing 7% annually. The approaching festive season is expected to boost the demand for residential properties.

title: US viral delivery driver's $700K fundraiser pulled after daughter posed as neighbour
'Leave us alone': 3 students say LPU posted rape 'truth' video without consent
description: Three female students from Lovely Professional University stated that a video of them was released without their consent. This video allegedly dismissed claims of a rape incident on campus involving a plumber. Following the allegations, students protested and vandalized property and blocked a highway for over 15 hours.

title: Katrina says mom left London for Tamil Nadu village to help kids
description: In 2008, Suzanne Turquotte relocated from London to Tamil Nadu with a mission to uplift local communities through her initiative, Relief Projects India. Initially providing free evening tuition for children, the organization broadened its scope to address a range of community needs. She also co-founded the Mountain View School, aiming to deliver English-language education to children in farming families.

title: US labor dept hints at 'total shutdown' of H-1B visa program
description: Anthony D'Esposito, Inspector General at the Department of Labor, announced an investigation into the H-1B visa program. Investigators are focusing on fraud related to foreign labor, which may lead to significant reforms. D'Esposito indicated that the program could look very different in one year. The administration is also examining colleges allegedly exploiting J-1 visas, as part of a wider crackdown.

title: Bill Gates Foundation to shut down in 2045: Why some Americans reject its $400m ‘gift’
description: The Bill Gates Foundation is making a bold move by committing $1 billion to ensure equitable AI development for education and healthcare. Of this, $400 million is dedicated to creating AI-driven tutoring systems that tailor learning experiences. This investment arrives amidst rising discussions about digital tools' effectiveness and privacy issues, with New York City already enacting a one-year pause on generative AI in schools.

title: 'Crushed man's head with stones': How Delhi murder accused evaded arrest for 24 years
description: A man named Firoj has been arrested after evading capture for 24 years. He was accused of murdering Kalaam Ansari due to a family vendetta. The incident occurred in February 2002 when Ansari's decomposed body was found in a DDA forest. Investigation revealed that Ansari had moved to Delhi for work with Firoj, who later committed the crime. The case highlights the challenges faced in resolving long-standing criminal investigations.

title: Once known for tree-lined avenues, craters define these posh areas in Bhopal now
description: BHEL township in Bhopal has experienced severe damage to roads due to recent monsoon rainfall. Residents are now navigating potholes, muddy stretches, and waterlogged patches daily. Commuters have reported increased vehicle breakdowns and accidents related to these conditions. While civic agencies promise repairs, residents find temporary fixes insufficient for long-term relief. There are urgent calls for comprehensive solutions to restore safety and the area's reputation.

title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s $2.9B investment: How did it reach 5,000 stores?
description: Jason Kelce has made a savvy equity investment in Hank Sauce via Winnie Capital, marking a significant step for both him and the brand. Once a local staple, Hank Sauce now boasts distribution in over 5,000 stores across the country. With a U.S. hot sauce market worth nearly $2.9 billion, this partnership looks to amplify Hank Sauce's visibility and reach nationally, taking advantage of the substantial growth opportunities ahead.

title: Thierry Henry lists combined SoHo penthouse for $25 million after 2026 renovation
description: Former footballer Thierry Henry has listed his SoHo penthouse in New York for $25 million. Henry bought the penthouse and the unit below for $14.85 million in 2010 and combined them into a roughly 6,000-square-foot home. He and his partner Andrea Rajacic renovated the property several times, including again in 2026.

title: 14-year-old Georgia student scores perfect 1600 on SAT
description: At just 14 years old, Ashrit Talluri from Georgia has achieved remarkable success, scoring a flawless 1600 on the SAT exam. Having earned 14½ high school credits in middle school, he is now taking college-level courses as a ninth grader at Innovation Academy. With five months of meticulous preparation behind him, Ashrit dreams of becoming a neurosurgeon, eager to delve into projects that combine cutting-edge technology with healthcare.
